scope_amendment: One active Managed Sprint per canonical project; no same-project parallel runs.

cases.positive: Installed schema/version/digest changes are reflected in text and file prompts; permissions and repository/task context are verified.
cases.negative: No source/runtime mutation or secret disclosure; oversized/unauthorized prompt rejected.

cases.positive: A JSON fixture based on the exported prompt passes envelope + actual managed validators.
cases.negative: External-model round trip remains NOT_RUN until a real model output and validation evidence are captured.

cases.positive: Text/document imports bind canonical project, actor, immutable Git manifest and source checksums.
cases.negative: Untrusted registry/root/transport overrides and ambiguous input rejected before workspace creation.

cases.positive: Strict JSON, shape, roles, graph, Git and permission failures have actionable stable errors.
cases.negative: Zero instance/workspace/task/process effects on invalid/unauthorized input; no duplicate keys/nonfinite values.

cases.positive: A new permitted run obtains distinct instance, branch/workspace and durable ownership.
cases.negative: Prepared/Waiting never enqueues task/review assignments or starts agent processes.

cases.positive: true activates using explicit current start/executor capabilities and the existing agent cycle.
cases.negative: Missing/revoked capability or executor yields a truthful blocked receipt, not fake Running.

cases.positive: false prepares and waits, then authorized Telegram/UI Start activates; legacy no-flag behavior remains.
cases.negative: Manual waiting snapshots contain no issued assignments; duplicate Start cannot spawn twice.

cases.positive: Three simultaneous different requests for the same canonical project: one accepted, two PROJECT_BUSY, including old/new API races.
cases.negative: Existing active/pending/prepared state is unchanged by losers; no alias projects or separate DBs bypass the slot.

cases.positive: Separate run worktrees/branches/results; file checksums resolve from source commit.
cases.negative: Traversal/reparse/dirty/diverged/lease conflict rejection; completed history retained.

cases.positive: Two existing test projects and successive runs have independent queues/state/logs.
cases.negative: Failure/cancel in one cannot mutate or stop another; no live project data fixtures.

cases.positive: Repeated update/message delivery and ambiguous ACK return the same persisted operation.
cases.negative: Changed payload with same key conflicts; another user cannot replay/read the saved result.

cases.positive: Three exact buttons, proper callback ownership and safe length; concurrent Start is idempotent.
cases.negative: Stale/cross-user/cross-instance callback denied, delivery retries do not repeat activation.

cases.positive: Crash injection at reserve/provision/prepare/activate/outbox boundaries preserves durable intent.
cases.negative: Manual parked attempts stay parked on restart; quotas/cancel free only proved owned resources.

cases.positive: Allowlisted gateway routes, fake tunnel outage/reconnect, independent engine execution.
cases.negative: Real authorized tunnel/mobile demonstration is separately gated; mocks never count as external evidence.

cases.positive: Valid private Mini App identity leads to one-use exchange and scoped session.
cases.negative: Tamper/stale/replay/racing exchange/wrong user/instance/revoke/CSRF/SSRF/WS/SSE and URL/log secret leakage denied.

cases.positive: Legacy/core/inbound/PR16 regressions, two distinct exact-commit reviews, reject/rework/reapproval.
cases.negative: No self approval or fake reports; release cannot be DONE without required actual external evidence and authorized PR.
